business_problem: A complex post-merger environment left the healthcare organization with an over-customized ServiceNow platform, technical debt, inconsistent processes, and multiple service systems that made support difficult to maintain and scale.
solution_summary: KPMG led a greenfield reimplementation of the organization's enterprise service-management environment on ServiceNow. The project standardized IT processes, consolidated more than five legacy systems, and unified IT, HR, and procurement services through a single employee portal. With common data and workflows in place, the organization enabled ServiceNow's virtual agent and AI Control Tower to support employee requests and reduce demand on live agents. KPMG coordinated more than a dozen workstreams and over 50 integrations, governed the redesign with a technical design authority, and supported a phased rollout for more than 200,000 employees and 10,000 fulfillers. The source does not name specific AI models or describe the virtual agent's data retrieval and processing architecture.
